analysis.scope: Whole-CLI timing/RSS; cpu_40, one thread per process, warmup 1, measured 3. Explicit adopted h=d=max(b,30)=100; no exact long-RNA accuracy claim. Joint (S,G) synthetic controls; embedded canonical pairs change sequence. Run/calibrate n250/500 tiers before n1000/2000/4000.

rerun.memory_basis: Explicit per-process RLIMIT_AS cap; allocation feasibility is not a measured RSS prediction.

historical_template_analysis.scope: Whole-CLI timing/RSS; node_f, one thread, warmup 1, measured 3. Explicit adopted h=d=max(b,30)=100; no exact long-RNA accuracy claim. Joint (S,G) synthetic controls; embedded canonical pairs change sequence. Run/calibrate n250/500 tiers before n1000/2000/4000.

synthetic_n250.basis: Planning envelope only: historical isolated h=d=30 E2 worst wall/n is below 0.07 s/nt/CLI.
